capabilities: Render HH:MM timestamps as colored capsule badges inside a configurable journal heading
Capture text, images, tasks, tags, and audio recordings into today's daily note from a sidebar
Dictate entries with real-time speech-to-text via an OpenAI-compatible transcription API
Randomly revisit past entries and bookmark favorites with a heart
Show yearly writing statistics with GitHub-style heatmaps and KPIs
extras: Distributed only through BRAT or manual file installation, not the community plugin store. Quick capture requires the built-in Daily Notes core plugin to be enabled; transcription stays off (plain recording only) unless an API endpoint and key are configured. README is written in Chinese with English/Chinese UI.
problem: Obsidian's Daily Notes gives you a plain file, with no visual timeline of timestamped entries, no quick capture panel, and no built-in way to review or count what you wrote over the year.

relations.evidence: 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/transcriptions 接口，接口/Key 留空则关闭转写
国内推荐（免费、可直连） —— 硅基流动 SiliconFlow 的 FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall

summary: Journal companion that highlights timestamps inside a daily-note Journal section and adds a sidebar for quick capture, random review, favorites, and yearly heatmap stats.
